title: BenchmarkCommand
responsibility: Registers benchmark validation, execution and persisted-result commands without changing other CLI operations.

inputs.name: registerBenchmarkCommand.program
inputs.description: The supplied Commander `Command` instance receives the `benchmark` command and its three children. It is required to register this CLI tree; the function does not return a replacement command.

outputs.name: registerBenchmarkCommand
outputs.description: The function returns no value after attaching `benchmark` with `validate`, `run`, and `results` child commands. Each child accepts `<target>` and the `--json` and `--seed <seed>` options; this function registers their actions but does not invoke them.
